digest.component_or_area: LLM verdict signing and provider provenance
propositions: A signed gate verdict must record not just the model string but also the provider, endpoint, tier, and effective capabilities, so consumers can distinguish verdicts from different provider backends even when the resolved model name is identical

The provider_provenance field must be added as an additive, optional key in the sidecar payload to preserve backward compatibility with older readers and avoid breaking store-compatibility constraints
The endpoint_host in provider_provenance must contain only the hostname (via urlparse.hostname, never netloc) to prevent credential material from leaking into the signed, persisted payload

The provider_provenance record must stamp the exact ModelCapabilities record that actually drove the run, never recomputed, because a second resolution can silently diverge from the capabilities that were enforced

The verdicts assembled by finalize_verdict in plan_review, completion, and code_review gates must be wired to receive the provider_provenance that runner.run() already produces, so the field reaches the persisted sidecar payload

The mechanism must remain backward-compatible so verdicts lacking provider_provenance (legacy or from runs where no provider was resolved) still load and verify without requiring migration or compatibility gates
